observations: The selected playback profile Science room and Fixture host remain distinct from the Morning room being edited in News bucket. Preparation status names the playback profile and explains where to edit it.
The scheduled recording shows its full script, source links, dated/undated references and partial-source warnings. The original HTTPS source URL reaches the captured main-side OS-open boundary.
No Last heard entry appears before actual speech. Native audio play and ended events establish On air, Paused, Played to the end and Interrupted statuses.
Switching the playback profile updates host and preparation status while retaining the actual heard script for this session. Separate freshly launched isolated sessions start with no heard item.

Controlled nextRoomNews handler failure displays Needs attention and an actionable error. Try again clears the error and shows Checking pool while a held read waits, then schedules the existing recording.

The final OS source-open call is captured; no external browser page opens.
